formal_two_step_split_theorem.fixed_invariance: A(E_s) subset E_s, A(E_u) subset E_u, B(E_s) subset E_s, and B(E_u) subset E_u
formal_two_step_split_theorem.projections_and_spaces: P_u=q f, P_s=I-q f, E_u=span{q}=ran(P_u), E_s=ker(f)=ran(P_s), and Sigma=E_s direct_sum E_u
formal_two_step_split_theorem.proof: expand P_s=I-qf and P_u=qf, use f(q)=1 for idempotence, use Aq=mu q and fA=mu f for commutation, and then multiply the exact identities; the rate statements follow from B_s^n=A_s^(2n) and scalar multiplication on E_u
formal_two_step_split_theorem.setting: Sigma is a Banach space, A in L(Sigma), q in Sigma, f in Sigma*, f(q)=1, Aq=mu q, and fA=mu f
formal_two_step_split_theorem.stable_rate_transfer: if ||A_s^n||<=K_s*rho_s^n, then ||B_s^n||<=K_s*rho_s^(2n); when K_s=1 this is rate rho_s^2
formal_two_step_split_theorem.two_step_definition: B:=A^2 is the linear two-step operator; B is not named a nonlinear selected return
formal_two_step_split_theorem.unstable_inverse_formula: if mu!=0, then B_u is invertible and ||(B_u)^(-n)||=|mu|^(-2n) for every n>=0 in any inherited norm on the one-dimensional E_u
formal_two_step_split_theorem.unstable_rate_transfer: if |mu|^(-1)<=rho_u<1, then ||(B_u)^(-n)||<=rho_u^(2n), with K_u=1 and backward rate rho_u^2

same_semiflow_time_composition.common_tube_gate: to obtain one Q intervening tube G, prove every first leg from N and every second leg from P(N) stays in the same G
same_semiflow_time_composition.one_return_hypotheses: P(x)=Phi_{theta(x)}(x) on D for one selected branch of the same semiflow, theta:D->(0,infinity) is continuous, and both legs are defined on D_2
same_semiflow_time_composition.period_at_fixed_point: if theta(p)=P_orbit, then Q(p)=p and Theta_2(p)=2*P_orbit
same_semiflow_time_composition.selected_hit_count: the composition records the chosen intermediate hit P(x) and the terminal hit P^2(x), but does not exclude other earlier or intervening section hits
same_semiflow_time_composition.semigroup_requirement: the identity uses the semiflow law and existence of the full concatenated trajectory; an abstract map composition is not enough
same_semiflow_time_composition.time_bounds: if 0<theta_lower<=theta<=theta_upper on N union P(N), then 2*theta_lower<=Theta_2<=2*theta_upper

stage4r_stable_germ_bridge.conclusion_if_all_hypotheses_hold: W_N^s(Q)=N intersect W_G^s(Gamma), hence equality of germs at p
stage4r_stable_germ_bridge.direct_route: on a local section patch N containing p, a continuous direct selected return Q:N->N of the same semiflow may be used without any identity Q=P^2
stage4r_stable_germ_bridge.graph_role: only a C2 hyperbolic stable-graph theorem for this same Q can identify its graph with the displayed periodic-orbit stable germ
stage4r_stable_germ_bridge.q_equals_p_squared_role: a sufficient nested-domain construction of Q, not a necessary hypothesis and not a replacement for time/tube/isolation data
stage4r_stable_germ_bridge.required_fixed_data: Gamma compact P_orbit-periodic, p in Gamma, Q(p)=p, and Theta(p)=m*P_orbit (m=2 for a near-two-period return)
stage4r_stable_germ_bridge.required_flow_data: Q(x)=Phi_{Theta(x)}(x) and one common G contains every Phi_s(x), x in N, 0<=s<=Theta(x)
stage4r_stable_germ_bridge.required_section_data: closure(N) intersect Gamma={p}, or the equivalent sequential section-isolation property
